content.text: The insurance clause meets every preferred element; no redline is warranted.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 fully satisfies the preferred position: CGL at USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional E&O at USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability at USD 5,000,000 (granted unconditionally, so it covers Vendor's processing of Customer Data), and workers' compensation as required by law. Section 18.2 provides certificates of insurance on request, and adds favourable extras for us (primary coverage, cancellation notice, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities). No redline needed; this sits at or above preferred, not merely fallback.
